what: A generated node body running in the live feed-triage service in place of the hand-written one (task 5.3). The body is the first attempt of the trial named below, rebuilt from its recorded source by `python -m poc.generation.harness rebuild`, which put it through the whole pipeline again; the driver then held the component to ClassifyItem's `with` clause before the tick (`python -m poc.serve --once --tier confined --substitute ClassifyItem=<file>`). The run record is the driver's own, copied from var/runs/.
limits: One body, one node, one tick. It shows that a generated body is interchangeable with the hand-written one on the graph that runs; it does not show that its classifications are as good. This body kept all 20 items it was shown, where the tightened hand-written prompt drops some: the contract cannot express selectivity, so nothing in the pipeline checks it.
